basic_info.description: Fantastic Opportunity to own a beautiful unit at One Hawthorne- a landmark condominium building centrally located in downtown San Francisco at Hawthorne and Howard Streets. 14c is a premium 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo with dramatic cityscape & sunset views of the San Francisco. The floor plan is spacious with plenty of  light. Premium-grade finishes are the hallmark of this wonderful home which includes a modern chef's kitchen, two luxurious full bathrooms , beautiful hardwood flooring and carpet, and designer fixtures. Additional conveniences include a bonus room, closet organizers, an in-unit washer/dryer (included), and central air and heating.  Building amenities include a fitness center, doorman, & a stunning roof deck with BBQ area with panoramic views also water, garbage and gas are included.  The building has 24 hour front desk attendance in the lobby, valet parking with electric vehicle charging stations, 26th floor panoramic roof access, and exercise and fitness room.
